title: ProductBrainManifest
description: Front-matter schema for .product-brain/manifest.md, one per indexed repo.

repo.description: Short name for this repo. Must match the `name` field in the orchestrator's config.yaml.

ticket_regex.description: Regex matched against commit subjects/bodies and PR titles to extract ticket IDs.

workflow.description: How PRs land on main. Determines whether merge commits or branch commits are the source of truth for diffs.

languages.description: Languages used in this repo. Hints for symbol extraction.

entry_points.description: Files the planning agent should consider as the repo's surface (e.g. main.py, index.tsx). Used for tentative-scope prediction in /pb-plan.

owners_file.description: Path to a CODEOWNERS-style file. Used to suggest reviewers.

ignore_paths.description: Path prefixes to exclude from file-list aggregation (vendor/, generated/, etc).

mega_file_threshold.description: Percentile cutoff for excluding 'mega-files' from clusters. 0.95 = exclude top 5% by churn.

last_indexed_sha.description: Last git SHA processed by backfill/incremental. Set by the tool, do not edit by hand.

index_cutoff_date.description: Date before which the 'every commit has a ticket ID' rule was not enforced. Records before this date are sparse.
